web.controls.mcp_name_required: Name the MCP server to start or stop.
web.controls.skill_name_required: Name the skill to pin or unpin.
web.controls.unsupported: This web UI cannot change that setting.
web.controls.on_required: Send "on": true to start the server or false to stop it.
web.controls.pinned_required: Send "pinned": true to pin the skill or false to unpin it.
web.ui.mcp.note: Like /mcp start and /mcp stop, this lasts while this web UI runs: on the next start, servers come back as configured.
web.ui.skill.pinnedOn: {name} pinned: it joins every turn of this session.
web.ui.skill.note: A pinned skill joins every turn of this session, as /skill pin does in the terminal. Manual-only skills run when you call them with /name.
